region: Central Region Zone 1 (Agona Swedru and Winneba-Apam Areas)
venue: Swedru School of Business (SWESBUS), Agona Swedru, Ghana

preEvent.title: Countdown to Camp Meeting 2026
preEvent.highlight: Arrival and Registration begins at 3:00 PM GMT
preEvent.message: Welcome campers, leaders, and visitors! We are preparing to kick off our 2026 Youth and Children's Camp Meeting at Swedru School of Business (SWESBUS). Content, live announcements, and service outlines will unlock live in real time as the program unfolds.
preEvent.tip: Have your registration fee ready (GHc 200 Regular / GHc 150 Under 13 / GHc 120 Non-residential). Pack your Bible, notebook, sportswear for Saturday games, and retro/throwback wear for Bonfire Night!

postEvent.title: Camp Meeting 2026 Concluded - Run To Win!
postEvent.highlight: The Race Continues in Your Local Assembly
postEvent.message: Glorious thanks to God Almighty for an unforgettable, life-transforming camp meeting at SWESBUS! As our National Leader declared: 'Together, let us Run To Win! TUTUTUTUTUTU VROOOOOOOOOM!' May the grace, fire, and determination received empower you to finish your race victoriously.

reveals.badge: 3:00 PM Live Reveal • Arrival and Welcome
reveals.title: Official Welcome from Leadership & Arrival Check-in
reveals.speaker: Ps. Enoch Bortey Offei (National Youth Leader) & Aps. Andrews Nortey (Superintendent)
reveals.verse: 1 Corinthians 9:24 — 'Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.'
reveals.teaser: Arrival and Welcome message unlocks at 3:00 PM GMT on Thursday, Sept 3.
reveals.summary: Camp registration is officially open at SWESBUS hostel premises! Read the inspiring opening pastoral welcome charges from our National Youth Leader and Superintendent.
reveals.contentHtml:
Dear Beloved Youth & Children,

It gives us immense joy and holy excitement to welcome every delegate, camper, minister, and volunteer to the 2026 Central Region Zone 1 Youth and Children's Camp Meeting at Swedru School of Business!

As our National Youth Leader Ps. Enoch Bortey Offei writes: 'The journey of life is not a casual walk but a purposeful race. Champions are not created by chance; they are built through discipline, perseverance, sacrifice, and a determination to finish well.'

Superintendent Aps. Andrews Nortey charges us: 'The one who runs to win goes into strict training (1 Cor. 9:25). Run in such a way that you may obtain the incorruptible crown.'

Arrival Instructions: Proceed to the registration desks at the main administration block to collect your tag, hostel allotment, and study materials. Freshen up and prepare for the 6:00 PM opening service!

reveals.title: Evening Opening Service: 'Everyone Born of God...'
reveals.speaker: Area Leadership & Opening Preacher
reveals.verse: 1 John 5:4 — 'For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.'
reveals.teaser: Evening opening service outline and order of service unlocks at 6:00 PM GMT on Thursday, Sept 3.
reveals.summary: Join us in the main auditorium for our first official gathering of Camp 2026. Here is the full order of service and focus for tonight's opening talk.
reveals.contentHtml:
Order of Opening Service:

  1. Opening Prayer
  2. Hymn & Opening Praise
  3. High Worship & Atmosphere Shift
  4. Introduction of Guests & Area Superintendents
  5. Special Song Ministration
  6. Opening Sermon: 'Everyone Born of God...' (1 John 5:4)
  7. Offertory & Thanksgiving
  8. Announcements & Camp Hostel Guidelines
  9. Closing Prayer & Benediction

Hostel Reminder: Lights out is strictly at 10:00 PM. Rest well in preparation for Friday's 5:00 AM Dawn Devotion!

reveals.title: Main Talk 1: 'Run Differently: Lay Aside Every Weight and Sin'
reveals.speaker: Ministers & Facilitators
reveals.teaser: Friday morning session details unlock at 10:00 PM GMT on Thursday, Sept 3.
reveals.summary: Friday Day 2 focuses on laying aside distractions, participating in action group discussions, and pressing into the Hour of Breakthrough and Deliverance.
reveals.contentHtml:
Day 2 kicks off early with 5:00 AM Dawn Devotion followed by 7:00 AM Start Right devotion in 1 Peter 1.

At 8:00 AM, Main Talk 1 explores the distinction between weights (hindrances and neutral habits that slow spiritual momentum) and sins (falling short of God's glory).

At 11:30 AM, join the Hour of Breakthrough & Deliverance based on John 8:36: 'If the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.'

reveals.title: Evangelism Outreach (Oteipirow) & Inspirational Career Night
reveals.speaker: Youth Ministry Facilitators & Guest Speakers
reveals.teaser: Friday outreach & career night details unlock at 12:30 PM GMT on Friday, Sept 4.
reveals.summary: Departing for community evangelism at Oteipirow at 2:00 PM, followed by Career Symposium & Personal Branding at 6:30 PM.
reveals.contentHtml:
2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Evangelistic invasion of Oteipirow town! Campers are deploying in organized teams to win souls for Christ Jesus. Dress code: Decent & comfortable walking wear.

6:30 PM: Inspirational Night — Career Choices, Personal Branding, and Vocational Excellence. Dress code: Rep Your School (JHS/SHS/Tertiary) OR Rep Your Jersey!

reveals.title: Study 2 & 3, Fun Games, Addictions Recovery & Bonfire Night
reveals.speaker: Overseer Jerry Dzirasah & Guest Speakers
reveals.teaser: Saturday program details unlock at 10:00 PM GMT on Friday, Sept 4.
reveals.summary: A full day of spiritual empowerment, athletic games at 2:00 PM, an addictions recovery talk at 6:30 PM, and the famous Camp Bonfire at 9:00 PM!
reveals.contentHtml:
Morning (7:00 AM - 12:30 PM): Start Right Talk 2 ('No More Shadowboxing') and Main Talk 3 ('Run With Endurance: Finish Well'), followed by Hour of Breakthrough ministrations.

Afternoon (2:00 PM): Inter-district sports, athletics, football, and team bonding games on SWESBUS grounds. Dress code: Sports/Casual.

Night (6:30 PM & 9:00 PM): Inspirational Night tackling substance and lifestyle addictions, followed by the Camp Bonfire & Variety Night at 9:00 PM. Dress code: Old School / Throwback / Retro Outfits!

reveals.title: Sunday Grand Climax: 'Run To Win' (1 Cor 9:24–26)
reveals.speaker: Area Superintendent & Apostolic Leadership
reveals.verse: 1 Corinthians 9:24–26 — 'Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training... we do it to get a crown that will last forever.'
reveals.teaser: Sunday Grand Climax Service outline unlocks at 10:00 PM GMT on Saturday, Sept 5.
reveals.summary: The pinnacle service of Camp Meeting 2026. All districts, youth, and children unite in worship, consecration, and sending-forth in official camp t-shirts.
reveals.contentHtml:
Climax Service Program:

Join the grand convocation at 8:00 AM. Dress code: Official 'Run To Win' Camp T-shirt.

Highlights include mass choir song ministration, presentation of camp awards, recognition of distinguished leaders, the powerful climax sermon, and the prophetic 'As You Go' impartation!
